name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Clip-on Extender
tagline: CLIP ON BASE EXTENDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL FOR RAISED FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Clip-on Extender is an attachment used at the base of adjustable pedestals to raise the height of pedestals by 10 mm in raised flooring systems. Extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has four clips that twist-clip into the base of the adjustable pedestal. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Clip-on Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® or SikaRoof® VersiJack® K pedestals. Extenders are typically used to correct for differences between design plans and site conditions, as opposed to going through the process of returning a particular pedestal model and reordering the correct pedestal height model.
